notes.title: v1.1 - Achievements and UI Edits
notes.content:
[b]Achievements Are Here![/b]
In response to player feedback, we've added 15 Steam Achievements to the game. We hope you have fun exploring them!


[b]Other Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Menu navigation with controller and keyboard more intuitive
[*] Highlighted buttons more clear when using controller and keyboard
[*] Class Upgrades section now shows cumulative stats for upgrades you've purchased
[*] Newly unlocked levels display "NEW" icon over preview
[*] Satchel bug fixed
[*] Gold and health items are more visible on pickup
[*] Some sound effect recalibration
[*] v1.1.1 Fixed achievement bug
[/list]

[b]What's Next[/b]
We consider this project to basically be complete, but we are exploring the idea of adding an endless/challenge mode with limitations on class upgrades. Let us know in the comments below if this is something you'd be interested in playing.


[b]Thank You For Playing[/b]
This is the first game we have completed and published on Steam, so we want to say thank you so much for your downloads and reviews. We're feeling very motivated to get started on our next project.

[b]Happy Halloween![/b]
